title: lets-move-as-much-workflow-configuration-into-th
description: lets move as much workflow configuration into the meta properties on the state machine definition as possible, ie enabling specifing the model/effort level/prompt for agents/etc basically anything that is currently hardcoded into phases in the code

researchNotes: Changeflow implementation is concentrated in `pi/extensions/changeflow/index.ts` and `pi/extensions/changeflow/subagents.ts`. `index.ts` owns the XState `machineDefinition`, state metadata types, prompt injection (`phasePrompt`), edit policy enforcement, allowed subagent roles, submission/review/plannotator mapping, and workflow persistence. `subagents.ts` owns role configs and hardcoded subagent tool/model/thinking/systemPrompt settings.

There is already a metadata pattern under `meta.changeflow`: `autoContinue`, `editPolicy`, `prompt.kind`, `reviewGate`, `plannotator`, and `submission`. Helper functions (`stateMeta`, `statesMatchingMeta`, `reviewStateForKind`, `submissionStatesForKind`, `submittedEventForKind`, and write blocking) consume this metadata rather than direct state conditionals. The requested change should extend this pattern instead of introducing another config layer.

Hardcoded workflow behavior that can move into state `meta.changeflow`: phase prompt text and orchestration instructions in `phasePrompt`; allowed subagent roles in `allowedSubagentRoles`; execution-order submit tool's explicit `activeWorkflow.state !== "execution_ordering"`/`ORDER_DEFINED` logic; perhaps artifact filenames/tool names for state submissions. Subagent model/thinking/tools/systemPrompt are hardcoded globally in `changeflowSubagentRoles` and should become per-state/per-role metadata overrideable from machine definition.

Subagent runner currently accepts only workflow/run fields and looks up `changeflowSubagentRoles[input.role]`. It supports `model` plus `thinking` by appending `:<thinking>` to model, `tools` via CLI `--tools`, and `systemPrompt` via temp file passed to `--append-system-prompt`. To make model/effort/prompt configurable by workflow phase, `ChangeflowSubagentRunInput` likely needs a resolved config or overrides passed from `index.ts`, while defaults remain in `subagents.ts`.

Docs already describe state metadata in `pi/extensions/changeflow/README.md`; implementation should update this section plus the roles/safety docs. Validation command is `cd pi/extensions/changeflow && npm run check` (TypeScript noEmit). Workflow JSON persists the current `machineDefinition`, so metadata remains serializable and should avoid functions.
decisions: Research completed: identified current metadata pattern, hardcoded phase/subagent configuration locations, likely change points, docs, and validation command.

Implemented metadata-driven Changeflow configuration: phase prompt instructions, subagent allowed roles, subagent config overrides, execution-order submission metadata, safer override merging, and README docs. Validation passed with `cd pi/extensions/changeflow && npm run check`.

QA passed: ran `cd pi/extensions/changeflow && npm run check`, QA subagent found no blocking issues, confirmed `prompt.kind`/`PromptKind` removed, and verified metadata-driven prompt/subagent/execution-order paths are present.
